name: controlled_gates
description: CX and CZ with both operand orders on three qubits (control and target are not interchangeable for CX).

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.cz(1, 0)
qc.cx(2, 0)
qc.cz(1, 2)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(3)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.CNOT(q[0], q[1]),
    cirq.CZ(q[1], q[0]),
    cirq.CNOT(q[2], q[0]),
    cirq.CZ(q[1], q[2]),
)
